body: Fixed. readJson now catches missing or malformed JSON and returns null so validation fails closed instead of throwing.
Fixed. Closeout construction now uses optional chaining and safe defaults for readiness, fallback, audit, and semantic-final inputs.
Fixed. Validator checks are emitted in strict byte-order by ID.
Fixed. The final closeout test now asserts the exact byte-ordered validator check IDs and verifies every check passes.
Fixed. Added a fail-closed regression test for null inputs and malformed input JSON.
